newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ Jan falls under 90.00, back months limit down.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ Jan falls under 90.00, back months limit down.

text.p: NYCE January frozen concentrated orange juice futures fell below support at 90.00 cents a lb, while the back months fell their 5.00-cent limit, pressured by technically driven speculative selling, market sources said.

At 1350 EST, January was down 5.45 cents at 89.60 cents, traded 94.60 to 89.50 cents, a fresh contract low. The back months limit down to to 4.00 lower, all having posted new contract lows earlier in the session.

Market sources blamed initial losses on Friday's January options expiry as 9,652 puts were exercised today. "Once options were gone, (selling ) took out support," Merrill Lynch analyst Judith Ganes said.
An absence of buyers put additional weight on the market while fund, commission house and trade selling triggered sell stops and values slipped through light support levels.

A lack of fundamental news and a quiet cash market fueled the downturn, said Celeste Georgakis, vice president with Dean Witter. She pegged nearby support in January at 90.00 cents, adding that the number was more of a psychological than a technical boundary.
Merrill's Ganes said that while the nearby fundamental outlook remains weak, orange juice promotions scheduled for the New Year could provide some underpinning for the market.
